title: Thursday, October 29th, 2026
summary: # Things have been a bit quiet round here for one reason or another, but I couldn't let today pass without the annual reminder to " choose the web you want " rather than just falling into big tech defaults. Whatever you do on the internet, do it on your own terms. Own your data and identity.
content:
# Things have been a bit quiet round here for one reason or another, but I couldn't let today pass without the annual reminder to "choose the web you want" rather than just falling into big tech defaults.

Whatever you do on the internet, do it on your own terms. Own your data and identity.
